title: Speaking: Powerful Adjectives
sub: Precise describing words for people, ideas, and situations.

cards.def:
Having a strong desire to succeed.
हिंदी: महत्वाकांक्षी
examples: Present: She is ambitious and works hard.
Past: He was ambitious from childhood.
Future: An ambitious student will aim high.
Perfect: She has always been ambitious.

cards.def:
Showing steady, careful effort.
हिंदी: परिश्रमी
examples: Present: A diligent student revises daily.
Past: He was diligent in his work.
Future: She will remain diligent.
Perfect: They have been diligent all term.

cards.def:
Not proud; modest.
हिंदी: विनम्र
examples: Present: A humble person listens.
Past: He remained humble after winning.
Future: She will stay humble.
Perfect: He has always been humble.

cards.def:
Willing to give freely.
हिंदी: उदार
examples: Present: A generous host shares food.
Past: He was generous with his time.
Future: She will be generous with praise.
Perfect: They have been generous donors.

cards.def:
Unwilling to change one's mind.
हिंदी: ज़िद्दी
examples: Present: A stubborn child refuses advice.
Past: He was stubborn about the plan.
Future: She will be stubborn in talks.
Perfect: He has always been stubborn.

cards.def:
Able to be trusted.
हिंदी: भरोसेमंद
examples: Present: A reliable friend keeps promises.
Past: He was reliable in a crisis.
Future: This car will stay reliable.
Perfect: She has proven reliable.

cards.def:
Honest and genuine in feeling.
हिंदी: सच्चा / निष्कपट

Past: His thanks were sincere.
Future: She will be sincere in her speech.
Perfect: He has been sincere with me.

cards.def:
Having too much pride in oneself.
हिंदी: घमंडी
examples: Present: An arrogant person ignores advice.
Past: He was arrogant after the win.
Future: Success will make him arrogant.
Perfect: She has become arrogant.

cards.def:
Careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
हिंदी: सतर्क

Past: He was cautious with money.
Future: Investors will be cautious.
Perfect: She has remained cautious.

cards.def:
Careless of danger.
हिंदी: लापरवाह
examples: Present: Reckless driving kills.
Past: He was reckless with money.
Future: A reckless move will cost him.
Perfect: She has been reckless lately.

cards.def:
Fluent and persuasive in speaking.
हिंदी: वाक्पटु
examples: Present: An eloquent speaker moves crowds.
Past: Her speech was eloquent.
Future: He will give an eloquent talk.
Perfect: She has become eloquent.

cards.def:
Producing strong, clear images in the mind.
हिंदी: जीवंत / स्पष्ट
examples: Present: A vivid story stays with you.
Past: She had vivid dreams.
Future: The film will leave vivid memories.
Perfect: He has given a vivid account.

cards.def:
Of little importance.
हिंदी: तुच्छ
examples: Present: A trivial issue shouldn't cause a fight.
Past: The error was trivial.
Future: The cost will be trivial.
Perfect: The matter has become trivial.

cards.def:
Extremely important.
हिंदी: अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण
examples: Present: Sleep is crucial for health.
Past: His advice was crucial.
Future: This meeting will be crucial.
Perfect: The data has been crucial.

cards.def:
Absolutely necessary.
हिंदी: आवश्यक
examples: Present: Water is essential for life.
Past: Her help was essential.
Future: Training will be essential.
Perfect: Practice has been essential.

cards.def:
Certain to happen.
हिंदी: अपरिहार्य
examples: Present: Change is inevitable.
Past: Defeat was inevitable.
Future: Delays will be inevitable.
Perfect: The outcome has been inevitable.

cards.def:
Large in amount or importance.
हिंदी: पर्याप्त / काफ़ी
examples: Present: A substantial meal fills you.
Past: He made a substantial profit.
Future: The gain will be substantial.
Perfect: She has made substantial progress.

cards.def:
Important enough to notice.
हिंदी: महत्वपूर्ण
examples: Present: A significant change affects all.
Past: It was a significant victory.
Future: The impact will be significant.
Perfect: Progress has been significant.

cards.def:
Less important or serious.
हिंदी: छोटा / मामूली
examples: Present: A minor injury heals quickly.
Past: It was a minor mistake.
Future: The change will be minor.
Perfect: The damage has been minor.

cards.def:
Easy to see or understand.
हिंदी: स्पष्ट

Past: His fear was obvious.
Future: The benefit will be obvious.
Perfect: The mistake has been obvious.

cards.def:
Not obvious; delicate.
हिंदी: सूक्ष्म
examples: Present: A subtle hint is easy to miss.
Past: She gave a subtle smile.
Future: The change will be subtle.
Perfect: He has made subtle changes.

cards.def:
Made of many connected parts.
हिंदी: जटिल
examples: Present: A complex problem needs time.
Past: The case was complex.
Future: The system will be complex.
Perfect: The issue has become complex.

cards.def:
Easy to understand or do.
हिंदी: सरल
examples: Present: A simple rule is easy to follow.
Past: The plan was simple.
Future: The task will be simple.
Perfect: The solution has been simple.

cards.def:
Easily broken or damaged.

Past: The peace was fragile.
Future: The deal will be fragile.
Perfect: The economy has remained fragile.

cards.def:
Strong and healthy.
हिंदी: मज़बूत
examples: Present: A robust system survives shocks.
Past: The economy was robust.
Future: Growth will remain robust.
Perfect: Sales have been robust.

cards.def:
Able to change easily.
हिंदी: लचीला
examples: Present: A flexible schedule helps parents.
Past: She was flexible about timing.
Future: The plan will be flexible.
Perfect: He has been flexible with deadlines.

cards.def:
Not able to change; stiff.
हिंदी: कठोर

Past: The system was rigid.
Future: The rules will remain rigid.
Perfect: He has been rigid in his views.

cards.def:
Working well without waste.
हिंदी: कुशल
examples: Present: An efficient worker saves time.
Past: The service was efficient.
Future: The new system will be efficient.
Perfect: She has been efficient all week.

cards.def:
Achieving a great deal.
हिंदी: उत्पादक
examples: Present: A productive day feels good.
Past: The meeting was productive.
Future: The talks will be productive.
Perfect: She has had a productive year.

cards.def:
Using new ideas or methods.
हिंदी: नवोन्मेषी

Past: Her design was innovative.
Future: The product will be innovative.
Perfect: The team has been innovative.

cards.def:
Concerned with real use, not theory.
हिंदी: व्यावहारिक

Past: His advice was practical.
Future: The plan will be practical.
Perfect: The course has been practical.

cards.def:
Showing awareness of what can be achieved.

cards.def:

cards.def:

cards.def:

cards.def:

cards.def:
Extremely angry.
हिंदी: क्रोधित

cards.def:
Completely tired.
हिंदी: थका हुआ

Past: She was exhausted after the climb.
Future: He will be exhausted tonight.
Perfect: I have been exhausted all week.

cards.def:
Having too much to deal with.
हिंदी: अभिभूत / दबा हुआ

Past: He was overwhelmed by emotion.

Perfect: I have been overwhelmed lately.

cards.def:
Feeling comfort after worry ends.
हिंदी: राहत महसूस करता

Past: She was relieved when he called.
Future: He will be relieved to hear it.

cards.def:
Feeling shy or ashamed.
हिंदी: शर्मिंदा

Past: He was embarrassed by the mistake.
Future: She will be embarrassed to see it.
Perfect: I have been embarrassed before.

cards.def:
Resentful of someone else's success.

Past: She was jealous of her sister.
Future: He will be jealous of the award.
Perfect: I have never been jealous.

cards.def:
Thankful.
हिंदी: आभारी

Past: She was grateful for the lift.
Future: He will be grateful for the advice.
Perfect: We have been grateful for support.

cards.def:
Eager to know or learn.
हिंदी: जिज्ञासु
examples: Present: A curious child asks many questions.
Past: She was curious about the box.
Future: He will be curious about the result.
Perfect: I have been curious for years.

cards.def:
Believing in one's own ability.
हिंदी: आत्मविश्वासी

Past: She was confident of victory.
Future: He will be confident on stage.

cards.def:
Feeling uneasy before something.
हिंदी: घबराया हुआ
examples: Present: I get nervous before interviews.
Past: He was nervous on stage.
Future: She will be nervous tomorrow.
Perfect: I have been nervous all day.

cards.def:
Having or showing great ability.
हिंदी: कुशल
examples: Present: A skilful surgeon works carefully.
Past: Her play was skilful.
Future: He will become skilful with practice.
Perfect: She has been skilful in negotiations.

cards.def:
Having natural ability.
हिंदी: प्रतिभाशाली
examples: Present: A talented singer wins hearts.
Past: He was a talented painter.
Future: She will be a talented leader.
Perfect: They have been talented from childhood.

cards.def:
Able to do many things.
हिंदी: बहुमुखी

Past: She was a versatile writer.
Future: He will prove versatile.
Perfect: The tool has been versatile.

cards.def:
Very careful about details.
हिंदी: सावधान / बारीकी से
examples: Present: A meticulous editor catches every error.
Past: He was meticulous in his notes.
Future: She will be meticulous with figures.
Perfect: They have been meticulous.

cards.def:
Done without planning.
हिंदी: सहज / स्वतःस्फूर्त
examples: Present: A spontaneous trip can be fun.
Past: Her laugh was spontaneous.
Future: The crowd will be spontaneous.
Perfect: The decision has been spontaneous.

cards.def:
Strange or unusual.
हिंदी: अजीब
examples: Present: A peculiar smell filled the room.
Past: He had a peculiar habit.
Future: It will seem peculiar at first.
Perfect: She has acted peculiar lately.

cards.def:
Difficult to understand or explain.
हिंदी: रहस्यमय
examples: Present: A mysterious letter arrived.
Past: The cause was mysterious.
Future: The case will remain mysterious.
Perfect: The man has been mysterious.

cards.def:
Extremely interesting.
हिंदी: आकर्षक / मनोहारी
examples: Present: A fascinating book keeps you reading.
Past: The lecture was fascinating.
Future: The visit will be fascinating.
Perfect: The story has been fascinating.

cards.def:
Boring and long.
हिंदी: उबाऊ
examples: Present: A tedious task tests patience.
Past: The lecture was tedious.
Future: The process will be tedious.
Perfect: The work has been tedious.

cards.def:
Extremely beautiful or impressive.
हिंदी: शानदार
examples: Present: A stunning view takes your breath away.
Past: The view was stunning.
Future: The result will be stunning.
Perfect: The film has been stunning.

cards.def:
Having plenty of room.
हिंदी: विशाल / खुला
examples: Present: A spacious hall holds crowds.
Past: The flat was spacious.
Future: The new office will be spacious.
Perfect: The room has been spacious enough.

cards.def:
Too small and crowded.
हिंदी: तंग
examples: Present: A cramped room feels stuffy.
Past: The train was cramped.
Future: The office will be cramped.
Perfect: The flat has been cramped.

cards.def:
Calm and quiet.
हिंदी: शांतिपूर्ण
examples: Present: A peaceful village rests at night.
Past: The evening was peaceful.
Future: The journey will be peaceful.
Perfect: The protest has remained peaceful.

cards.def:
In complete disorder.
हिंदी: अव्यवस्थित
examples: Present: A chaotic market is noisy.
Past: The scene was chaotic.
Future: The morning will be chaotic.
Perfect: The week has been chaotic.

cards.def:
Unfriendly and aggressive.
हिंदी: शत्रुतापूर्ण
examples: Present: A hostile crowd shouted.
Past: The reception was hostile.
Future: The talks will be hostile.
Perfect: The press has been hostile.

cards.def:
Kind and pleasant.
हिंदी: मित्रवत
examples: Present: A friendly neighbour greets everyone.
Past: The staff were friendly.
Future: The locals will be friendly.
Perfect: He has always been friendly.

cards.def:
Welcoming to guests.
हिंदी: मेहमाननवाज़
examples: Present: A hospitable family feeds visitors.
Past: The villagers were hospitable.
Future: The hosts will be hospitable.
Perfect: They have been hospitable.

cards.def:
Full of people.
हिंदी: भीड़-भाड़ वाला
examples: Present: A crowded train is uncomfortable.
Past: The market was crowded.
Future: The stadium will be crowded.
Perfect: The streets have been crowded.

cards.def:
Empty of people.

Future: The beach will be deserted in winter.
Perfect: The village has been deserted for years.

cards.def:

हिंदी: प्राचीन

Future: The relic will remain ancient.
Perfect: The city has stayed ancient in spirit.

cards.def:
Of the present or recent times.
हिंदी: आधुनिक
examples: Present: A modern office uses digital tools.
Past: The design was modern.
Future: The hospital will be modern.
Perfect: The town has become modern.

cards.def:
Needing immediate attention.
हिंदी: अत्यावश्यक
examples: Present: An urgent message needs a reply.
Past: The matter was urgent.
Future: The repair will be urgent.

cards.def:

हिंदी: दुर्लभ / कम

Past: Jobs were scarce.
Future: Food will be scarce.
Perfect: Resources have been scarce.

cards.def:
Existing in large quantities.
हिंदी: प्रचुर
examples: Present: Fruit is abundant in summer.
Past: Rain was abundant that year.
Future: Food will be abundant.
Perfect: Resources have been abundant.

cards.def:
Regular and not changing.
हिंदी: स्थिर
examples: Present: A steady income gives security.
Past: Growth was steady.
Future: Progress will be steady.
Perfect: Sales have been steady.

cards.def:

हिंदी: अचानक
examples: Present: A sudden noise startles us.
Past: The change was sudden.
Future: A sudden storm will pass.
Perfect: The drop has been sudden.

cards.def:
Happening slowly over time.
हिंदी: क्रमिक

Future: The rise will be gradual.
Perfect: Improvement has been gradual.

cards.def:

हिंदी: अस्थायी

Future: The ban will be temporary.
Perfect: The measure has been temporary.

cards.def:

हिंदी: स्थायी

Future: The move will be permanent.
Perfect: The change has been permanent.

cards.def:

Past: Attendance was mandatory.
Future: Helmets will be mandatory.
Perfect: Training has been mandatory.

cards.def:

हिंदी: वैकल्पिक

Past: The course was optional.
Future: The trip will be optional.
Perfect: The test has been optional.

cards.def:
Qualified to receive or do something.
हिंदी: पात्र

Future: He will be eligible next year.

cards.def:

हिंदी: वैध / मान्य

cards.def:

cards.def:

cards.def:

हिंदी: उचित

Future: The plan will be reasonable.
Perfect: The offer has been reasonable.

cards.def:
Silly and absurd.

Future: The price will be ridiculous.
Perfect: The claim has been ridiculous.

cards.def:
Causing admiration.
हिंदी: प्रभावशाली
examples: Present: An impressive speech earns applause.
Past: The result was impressive.
Future: The show will be impressive.
Perfect: Her record has been impressive.

cards.def:
Failing to meet hopes.
हिंदी: निराशाजनक
examples: Present: A disappointing result upsets fans.
Past: The film was disappointing.
Future: The outcome will be disappointing.
Perfect: The year has been disappointing.

cards.def:
Worthy of notice; extraordinary.
हिंदी: उल्लेखनीय
examples: Present: A remarkable talent stands out.
Past: Her recovery was remarkable.
Future: The result will be remarkable.
Perfect: He has shown remarkable courage.

cards.def:
Normal; not special.
हिंदी: साधारण
examples: Present: An ordinary day can bring surprises.

Future: It will be an ordinary week.
Perfect: He has led an ordinary life.

cards.def:
Very unusual or remarkable.
हिंदी: असाधारण
examples: Present: An extraordinary effort wins praise.
Past: Her talent was extraordinary.
Future: The event will be extraordinary.
Perfect: He has shown extraordinary skill.

cards.def:
Well known from experience.
हिंदी: परिचित
examples: Present: A familiar face feels comforting.
Past: The song was familiar.
Future: The route will be familiar.
Perfect: The place has always been familiar.

cards.def:
Being the only one of its kind.
हिंदी: अद्वितीय
examples: Present: A unique idea stands out.
Past: Her style was unique.
Future: The design will be unique.
Perfect: The result has been unique.

Future: Support will be widespread.

cards.def:
Shared by two or more parties.
हिंदी: आपसी
examples: Present: Mutual respect builds friendships.
Past: The feeling was mutual.
Future: The benefit will be mutual.
Perfect: Their trust has been mutual.

cards.def:
Very intense or aggressive.
हिंदी: तीव्र / उग्र
examples: Present: Fierce competition drives innovation.
Past: The storm was fierce.
Future: The battle will be fierce.
Perfect: The debate has been fierce.

cards.def:
Cruel or severe.
हिंदी: कठोर
examples: Present: Harsh winters kill crops.
Past: The criticism was harsh.
Future: The punishment will be harsh.
Perfect: The weather has been harsh.
